text: At 15 September 2025 Media Capital's holders of 5% or more of capital and voting rights were Pluris Investments, S.A. (37.11%), Triun, SGPS, S.A. (23%), BIZ Partners, SGPS, S.A. (11.9725%), CIN - Corporação Industrial do Norte, S.A. (11.20%) and Zenithodyssey, Lda (10%). Pluris Investments is businessman Mário Ferreira's investment group; Ferreira is chairman of Media Capital's board.
short: Media Capital's large shareholders are private vehicles; the biggest is Mário Ferreira's Pluris (37.11%).

source.name: Media Capital: Ação Media Capital / Estrutura Acionista (shareholder disclosure)
source.quote: Pluris Investments, S.A. Triun, SGPS, S.A. BIZ Partners, SGPS, S.A. CIN – Corporação Industrial do Norte, S.A. Zenithodyssey – Lda. 37,11% 23% 11,9725% 11,20% 10%
source.note: Current shareholding table, headed 'A 15 de setembro de 2025' ['at 15 September 2025']; listed in the same order as the name column, i.e. Pluris 37.11%, Triun 23%, BIZ Partners 11.9725%, CIN 11.20%, Zenithodyssey 10%.

additionalSources.name: RTP Notícias (Lusa): Estrutura acionista da Media Capital fica 'definitivamente estabilizada', diz Mário Ferreira
additionalSources.quote: A Pluris Investments, do empresário Mário Ferreira, adquiriu 5,16% da Media Capital
additionalSources.note: Page undated; Lusa report of the August 2021 overriding takeover offer. Translation: 'Pluris Investments, of businessman Mário Ferreira, acquired 5.16% of Media Capital'; the same report calls Media Capital 'dona da TVI' ['owner of TVI'] and notes Ferreira chairs its board.
